title: Cyrene
lead: A Greek city of North Africa whose people appear in the Gospels and Acts: Simon of Cyrene (Mark 15:21), the Cyrenians' synagogue (Acts 6:9), "parts of Libya near Cyrene" (Acts 2:10) and Lucius the Cyrenian (Acts 13:1). Tacitus records its people's charge against a Roman governor (Histories 4:45).
